name: equity79_causal_reconstruction_v1
accounting: Chen reference annual formulas; available six calendar months after fiscal year end; latest standard consolidated domestic industrial record; expire after 18 months
accounting_vintage: 2026 WRDS standard restated Compustat, not historical snapshots
market_features: daily updates; months approximated by 21 trading days; one year 252 days; Beta correlation 1260 days
rank: per-date, within selected 500-stock annual cohort; average ties; (rank-1)/(n-1)-0.5; missing=0; RF retained as common unranked daily rate
medians: within same cohort, before rank normalization; Table 11 transforms on daily grid; log invalid if <=0; invalid differences imputed from training median; scale by training standard deviation; clip +/-10
volume: five-session sum of contemporaneous unadjusted shares traded (Table 10 weekly volume); split adjustments only in ratios where the final-vintage scale cancels
initial_holdings: cash at the first test date; thereafter align prior weights by PERMNO, including yearly exits
cohort: EQTY/COM with complete daily returns in train and test, largest previous year final-session cap; ties by PERMNO; paper's ex-post completeness retained
feature_timing: X through close t produces weight for excess return t+1; train standardization uses only predictor rows associated with training targets
inference: causal finite receptive field; overlap preceding 186 predictor days at evaluation boundaries
assessment: five-seed gross comparison to Table 4, all six metrics; approximate Sharpe match tolerance paper seed SD 0.12 for Set-Sequence and 0.14 for LongConv; these are descriptive bands, not confidence intervals
